lcc_original: 永恆主說：『我要將我所創造的人類、都從地上擦滅：無論人類獸類或爬行動物，以及空中的飛鳥，都要擦滅，因爲我後悔造了他們。』
notes: LCC uses 人類 twice (main clause + enumeration) where UNV has a single 人 carrying all SNs for both Hebrew occurrences (הָאָדָם and מֵהָאָדָם). Split: first 人類 receives <WH0120> for the main-clause object; second 人類 receives <WAH04480><WH0120> for the enumeration head מֵהָאָדָם. The UNV implicit {<WH0120>} after 除滅 is resolved to the explicit first 人類 per Rule 3 (LCC has an explicit word).

LCC restructures the three-term enumeration as 無論人類獸類或爬行動物 rather than UNV's 人…走獸…昆蟲. No explicit conjunction precedes 獸類, so <WH05704> (עַד 'to/until') is folded onto 獸類 itself. 或 parallels UNV's 並 and receives <WAH05704> for the second עַד.
LCC repeats 擦滅 at the close of the enumeration (都要擦滅) as a stylistic device with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.

LCC's reason clause 因爲我後悔造了他們 follows Hebrew word order (נִחַמְתִּי then עֲשִׂיתִם), the inverse of UNV's 我造他們後悔了. The implicit {<WAH03588>} for the second כִּי ('that') is placed between 後悔 and 造了他們 where the subordinating conjunction would naturally sit.
LCC inserts an explicit 我 in 我所創造 (absent in UNV's 所造的); left unannotated as a Chinese syntactic addition.
